findings.claim: In concatenatedRSToASN1DER, lines 114-115 call ASN1Encoder.create().write(rBigInteger) and ASN1Encoder.create().write(sBigInteger) and discard the results. The return statement at lines 117-121 repeats the encoding with new encoders, so lines 114-115 are dead code.

verifier.reason: In AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:114-115, ASN1Encoder.create().write(rBigInteger) and ASN1Encoder.create().write(sBigInteger) write into fresh ByteArrayOutputStream instances (ASN1Encoder.java:38-49) with no side effects and discard the returned encoders, while AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:117-121 repeats both encodings with new ASN1Encoder instances.

findings.claim: CryptoIntegration.detectProvider() no longer throws the fail-fast 'Multiple crypto providers loaded' IllegalStateException; it picks the highest order() instead. The Default, Elytron and FIPS1402 providers all return 200, so a tie is decided by ServiceLoader/classpath order. For example, a FIPS deployment with a stray crypto-default jar can run on non-FIPS BouncyCastle without failing.

verifier.reason: In common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/crypto/CryptoIntegration.java:55-73, detectProvider() removed the IllegalStateException on multiple providers and returns foundProviders.get(0) after sorting by order() descending without checking for ties. Because DefaultCryptoProvider (crypto/default/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/def/DefaultCryptoProvider.java:83-85), WildFlyElytronProvider (crypto/elytron/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/elytron/WildFlyElytronProvider.java:76-78), and FIPS1402Provider (crypto/fips1402/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/fips/FIPS1402Provider.java:114-116) all return 200, a tie is silently decided by ServiceLoader classpath order with ignored providers only logged at debug level.

findings.claim: concatenatedRSToASN1DER() assumes signature.length == signLength without validating it. A malformed signature can throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of IOException.

verifier.reason: In authz/client/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/client/util/crypto/AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:103-110, concatenatedRSToASN1DER() copies len = signLength / 2 bytes twice from signature via System.arraycopy() without checking signature.length == signLength. A malformed shorter signature therefore throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of the declared IOException, though callers such as core/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/ECDSASignatureVerifierContext.java:25-32 catch Exception.
